name: Assassin trained unit after load diagnostic

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code:
local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_Assassin; local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ASN_LIVE_TEST'); assert(R and t)
local text={}; local wanted={t.LockState.LastProducedUnit,t.FinalState.LastProducedUnit}
for _,id in ipairs(wanted) do local u=Players[t.Actor]:GetUnits():FindID(id)
 text[#text+1]='turn='..R.Turn()..' trained='..id..' exists='..tostring(u~=nil)
 if u then
 text[#text+1]='type='..GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType..' xy='..u:GetX()..','..u:GetY()..' owner='..u:GetOwner()..' damage='..u:GetDamage()
 for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local other=p:GetID()
  if other~=t.Actor then for _,v in Players[other]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if v:GetX()>=0 and Map.GetPlotDistance(u:GetX(),u:GetY(),v:GetX(),v:GetY())<=3 then
    text[#text+1]='near='..other..':'..v:GetID()..':'..GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].UnitType..':'..v:GetX()..','..v:GetY()..':war='..tostring(Players[t.Actor]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(other))
   end
  end end
 end
end
end
for _,u in Players[t.Actor]:GetUnits():Members() do text[#text+1]='all='..u:GetID()..':'..GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType..':'..u:GetX()..','..u:GetY() end
local text=table.concat(text,'; '); print('[JAC_ASN_DIAG] '..text); return text
